benchmark_compatibility.evidence: The TS headless benchmark targets the same Rust REST/admin/WebSocket API paths: /admin/instances, /admin/metrics/streams, /ws/sessions/:id/stream, /api/sessions/:id/mgba-http/button/tap, and /api/sessions/:id/core/read8.
benchmark_compatibility.failure_detail: POST /admin/instances failed: 500 {"error":"process error: worker socket did not appear within 10s"}
benchmark_compatibility.blocker: Full benchmark execution requires mGBA libretro core and test ROM runtime inputs (LIBRETRO_CORE_PATH and TEST_ROM_PATH) so the worker can start and expose its socket.

performance_targets.reduced_target_note: --allow-reduced-target is valid for local compatibility checks but is not a strict performance acceptance pass.

api_compatibility: All benchmark-required REST/admin/WebSocket paths match the Rust server API surface; authentication uses X-Admin-Token for admin paths and bearer principal tokens for session paths.
